table.retrieve:
SELECT 
	itemname = case printable when  0  then ltrim(str(item.icode)) + ' Counter Sale'   else item.name end,
	itemcounter=1,
	reprintdate=getdate(),
	users.username,  
	accounts.name,
	headerno =max(saleledger.headerno),
	dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode,   
	dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode,   
	date =dbo.saleledger.date,
	dbo.saleledger.discperc,   
	dbo.saleledger.misccharges,   
	dbo.saleledger.flatdisc,   
	dbo.saleledger.salestax,   
	dbo.saleledger.custcode,   
	dbo.saleledger.remarks,
	dbo.saleledger.custrefno,	
	dbo.saledetail.icode,   
	dbo.saledetail.gcode,
	max(saleledger.salecatcode),
	Id        = MAX(dbo.saledetail.IDENTITYCOL),     
	looseqty  = sum(saledetail.looseqty), 
	packqty   = sum(saledetail.packqty), 
	packunits = max(saledetail.packunits), 
	saleprice = max(saledetail.saleprice), 
	rate      = max(saledetail.rate),
	salestax  = max(saledetail.salestax),   
	discperc  = max(saledetail.discperc), 
	customername='                                  '  ,
	itemflatdisc  = max(saledetail.itemflatdisc),
	unitsalestax  = max(saledetail.unitsalestax),
	gstperc       = max(saledetail.gstperc),
	invgstperc    = max(saleledger.invgstperc1),
	reprintcounter=max(saleledger.reprintingcounter),
	patient=(select patient.name from patient where patient.patientcode=:ra_patientCode),
	patientreg=(select patient.regno from patient where patient.patientcode=:ra_patientCode),
	doctor=(select doctors.name from doctors where doctors.doctcode=max(saleledger.doctcode)),
	disease=(select name from disease where disease.DiseaseCode=max(saleledger.DiseaseCode)),
	invtotal=dbo.saleledger.invtotal,
	type='S',
	OtherCharges=ISNULL(
		(SELECT SUM(GD.Debit) 
		FROM GLDetail GD 
		WHERE GD.PatientCode = :ra_patientcode), 0),
	Discount=ISNULL(
		(SELECT SUM(GD.Credit) 
		FROM GLDetail GD 
		WHERE GD.PatientCode = :ra_patientcode), 0)
FROM 
	dbo.saleledger,   
	dbo.saledetail,  
	item, 
	customer, 
	accounts,
	users 
	
WHERE 
	( dbo.saleledger.date BETWEEN :adt_startdate AND :adt_enddate ) AND
	( dbo.saleledger.patientcode = :ra_patientCode ) AND
	( dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode = dbo.saledetail.saleinvcode ) AND 
	( dbo.saleledger.custcode = dbo.customer.custcode ) AND 
	( dbo.customer.custcode = dbo.accounts.acccode ) AND 
	( dbo.saleledger.salesmancode = dbo.users.usercode ) AND
	( saledetail.icode = item.icode ) 
	
GROUP BY 
	saleledger.saleinvcode, 
	saleledger.date, 
	/*saleledger.headerno,*/
	saleledger.custcode, 
	saleledger.discperc, 
	saleledger.flatdisc, 
	saleledger.misccharges, 
	saleledger.salestax, 
	saleledger.remarks,
	saleledger.custrefno, 
	saledetail.icode, 
	saledetail.rowgroup,
	saledetail.gcode, 
	item.name,
	item.icode,
	item.printable, 
	accounts.name,
	dbo.users.username,
	dbo.saleledger.invtotal
UNION ALL
SELECT 
	itemname = case printable when  0  then ltrim(str(item.icode)) + ' Counter S/Return'   else item.name end,
	itemcounter=1,
	reprintdate=getdate(),
	users.username,  
	accounts.name, 
	headerno =max(srledger.headerno),
	dbo.srledger.srinvcode,
	dbo.srledger.saleinvcode,   
	date =dbo.srledger.date,
	dbo.srledger.discperc,   
	dbo.srledger.misccharges,   
	dbo.srledger.flatdisc,   
	dbo.srledger.salestax,   
	dbo.srledger.custcode,   
	dbo.srledger.remarks,
	dbo.srledger.custrefno,	
	dbo.srdetail.icode,   
	dbo.srdetail.gcode,
	max(srledger.srcatcode),
	Id = NULL,     
	looseqty  = sum(srdetail.looseqty), 
	packqty   = sum(srdetail.packqty), 
	packunits = max(srdetail.packunits), 
	saleprice = max(srdetail.srprice), 
	rate      = max(srdetail.srprice),
	salestax  = max(srdetail.salestax),   
	discperc  = max(srdetail.discperc), 
	customername='                                  '  ,
	itemflatdisc  = 0,
	unitsalestax  = max(srdetail.unitsalestax),
	gstperc       = max(srdetail.gstperc),
	invgstperc    = max(srledger.invgstperc1),
	reprintcounter=0,
	patient=(select patient.name from patient where patient.patientcode=:ra_patientCode),
	patientreg=(select patient.regno from patient where patient.patientcode=:ra_patientCode),
	doctor=(select doctors.name from doctors where doctors.doctcode=max(srledger.doctcode)),
	disease=NULL,
	invtotal= - (dbo.srledger.invtotal),
	type='SR',
	OtherCharges=0,
	Discount=0
FROM 
	dbo.srledger,   
	dbo.srdetail,  
	item, 
	customer, 
	accounts,
	users 
	
WHERE 
	( dbo.srledger.date BETWEEN :adt_startdate AND :adt_enddate ) AND
	( dbo.srledger.patientcode = :ra_patientCode ) AND
	( dbo.srledger.srinvcode = dbo.srdetail.srinvcode ) AND 
	( dbo.srledger.custcode = dbo.customer.custcode ) AND 
	( dbo.customer.custcode = dbo.accounts.acccode ) AND 
	( dbo.srledger.salesmancode = dbo.users.usercode ) AND
	( srdetail.icode = item.icode ) 
	
GROUP BY 
	srledger.srinvcode, 
	srledger.saleinvcode,
	srledger.date, 
	/*saleledger.headerno,*/
	srledger.custcode, 
	srledger.discperc, 
	srledger.flatdisc, 
	srledger.misccharges, 
	srledger.salestax, 
	srledger.remarks,
	srledger.custrefno, 
	srdetail.icode, 
	srdetail.gcode, 
	item.name,
	item.icode,
	item.printable, 
	accounts.name,
	dbo.users.username,
	dbo.srledger.invtotal
	
ORDER BY 
	Type,
	saleledger.saleinvcode,
	MAX(dbo.saledetail.IDENTITYCOL)
table.sort: type A, saleinvcode A, saleledger_saleinvcode A, id A

objects.name: compute_3
objects.expression: sum (invtotal for all distinct saleinvcode) + max( othercharges ) - max(discount)

objects.name: compute_7
objects.expression: sum (if(type='SR', invtotal, 0) for all distinct type, saleinvcode)

objects.name: compute_6
objects.expression: sum (if(type='S', invtotal, 0) for all distinct type, saleinvcode)

objects.name: c_sumitemleveltaxval
objects.expression: sum(round( c_amount  *  gstperc * 0.01, 2) +  Round(looseqty * unitsalestax ,2) for group 1)

objects.name: c_totaltax
objects.expression: Round(Round((Round(sum((round(c_amount,2) ) for all)  *  (1 - saleledger_discperc * 0.01) ,2) -  saleledger_flatdisc  )  *  invgstperc  * 0.01,2) + sum(c_salestaxval for all) , 0)

objects.name: c_invsalestaxval
objects.expression: Round((Round(sum((round(c_amount,2) ) for group 1)  *  (1 - saleledger_discperc * 0.01),2) -  saleledger_flatdisc  )  *  invgstperc  * 0.01,2)

objects.name: c_nettotal
objects.expression: /*Round(Sum (  c_netamount for all ) -  saleledger_flatdisc  +  saleledger_misccharges  + saleledger_salestax , 0)*/Round(Sum (  c_netamount for group 1 ) -  saleledger_flatdisc  +  saleledger_misccharges  + saleledger_salestax , 0)  + Round(sum(c_salestaxval for group 1 ) + Round((Round(sum((round(c_amount,2) ) for group 1)  *  (1 - saleledger_discperc * 0.01) , 2) -  saleledger_flatdisc  )  *  invgstperc  * 0.01,2),0)
